_about: Kit code -> parts [MyDrop size sku, qty needed]. A kit with no own MyDrop stock is in stock when every part is (owner, 19 Oct 2026). REBUILT 15 Nov 2026 (owner: «rebuild», after 8037 showed made to order with all parts in stock): compositions now come from MyDrop's own set data (web cabinet backend, product isSet / childProducts — one entry per unit), not from descriptions. A multi-colour part = the size whose title equals the colour in the set's MyDrop title. «kits» = sets whose every part is a product the connector can read (applied by build_feed.py). «web_only» = sets with at least one HIDDEN part (cover or pack that MyDrop shows only inside the set page; get_product answers «Товар недоступен…») — their parts are written «h:<MyDrop product id>» and their stock comes from refresh/web_parts_state.json, which the browser check (refresh/WEBPARTS_RUNBOOK.md, owner 15 Nov 2026) reads from the set pages; build_feed.py uses it only while it is under 8 hours old — otherwise these sets fall back to made to order. «signature» = the set's composition (child product id*qty) when it was mapped; the browser check reports a set whose composition changed and that set is not computed until it is re-mapped. «unresolved» = no size of the needed colour on MyDrop. 83020 / 83020-2-К: MyDrop's set lists vest 1005-0101-L, kept 1005-0101-XL (XL kit) — to confirm with Kiborg.
